name: dev-flow
description: Exploratory development wrap-up flow: accumulate wip commits on a dev branch, then triage them into clean topic branches. Also enforces the dev-branch discipline with three hooks.

description_i18n.en: Exploratory development wrap-up flow: accumulate wip commits on a dev branch, then triage them into clean topic branches. Also enforces the dev-branch discipline with three hooks.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 探索式开发的收口流程：dev 分支上积累 wip 提交，定期拆成干净的主题分支；并用三个 hook 约束「草稿落 dev」。
